SELECT s.s_idx AS spc_idx, s.b_idx AS brn_idx, b.b_name AS brn_name, s.s_name AS spc_name, s.s_type AS spc_type, s.s_price AS spc_price, s.s_max_capacity AS spc_max_capacity, s.s_description AS spc_description, s.s_img AS spc_img, s.s_active AS spc_active, s.s_created AS spc_created, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r WHERE r.s_idx = s.s_idx) AS reservation_cnt FROM space s LEFT JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx
ORDER BY s.s_created DESC LIMIT #{numPerPage} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.s_idx AS spc_idx, s.b_idx AS brn_idx, b.b_name AS brn_name, s.s_name AS spc_name, s.s_type AS spc_type, s.s_price AS spc_price, s.s_max_capacity AS spc_max_capacity, s.s_description AS spc_description, s.s_img AS spc_img, s.s_active AS spc_active, s.s_created AS spc_created FROM space s LEFT JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE s.s_active = 0 ORDER BY s.s_created ASC

SELECT s.s_idx AS spc_idx, s.b_idx AS brn_idx, b.b_name AS brn_name, s.s_name AS spc_name, s.s_type AS spc_type, s.s_price AS spc_price, s.s_max_capacity AS spc_max_capacity, s.s_description AS spc_description, s.s_img AS spc_img, s.s_active AS spc_active, s.s_created AS spc_created, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r WHERE r.s_idx = s.s_idx) AS reservation_cnt FROM space s LEFT JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE s.s_idx = #{spcIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO space (b_idx, s_name, s_type, s_price, s_max_capacity, s_description, s_img, s_active, s_created) VALUES (#{brnIdx}, #{spcName}, #{spcType}, #{spcPrice}, #{spcMaxCapacity}, #{spcDescription}, #{spcImg}, #{spcActive}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b_idx AS brn_idx, b_name AS brn_name FROM branch ORDER BY b_name
